hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross the street.

hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.description: Residential stoops and stairs encroach onto the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the usable walking space and pushing pedestrians toward the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Installing street trees would provide a vertical buffer between pedestrians and traffic while also helping to calm traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Adding curb extensions at the ends of the block would improve visibility and reduce crossing distances for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly delineate pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.title: Daylighting

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer

interventions.title: Pavement Repair

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
